title: The Failing Glass Factory in Fujian That Nobody Dared Take Over
conflicts: Terms of the 1983 takeover: Fuyao's timeline says he contracted the factory, the FT says the local government sold it to him, Ernst & Young and Glass International say he was invited to take it over; the story gives the company's and the FT's versions side by side. The slate's 1987 date is the founding of Fuyao; the takeover was 1983 and the pivot 1985 (Caixin's paywalled timeline says 1986 and dates the founding to 1995; not used). Rmb200,000 profit and Rmb50/Rmb1,500 figures are FT-only and attributed to it.
notes: Company field avoids the word 'factory' because the repeat screen matched it to Zhang Ruimin's Haier refrigerator factory (1985). Founder is also known as Cho Tak Wong. FT article cited via euro2day.gr's licensed republication.
